title: The school district’s general fund on each budget
question: What do the school district’s and county office’s budgets show for revenue, spending, deficits and reserves?
finding: The June 2026 forms show the district’s general fund spending $1.31 billion in 2025-26 (estimated) and budgeting $1.36 billion for 2026-27. The unrestricted fund fell by $133.4 million in 2025-26, of which $111.5 million was a transfer out to another fund; the 2026-27 budget holds a reserve for economic uncertainties of $27.2 million.
how: Form 01 lines A5 (total revenues), B9 (total expenditures), D1b (transfers out), E (net change in fund balance), F2 (ending balance) and the 9789 and 9790 reserve lines, in the prior-year estimated-actual column and the budget-year column, total of unrestricted and restricted; the unrestricted net change is shown beside.
limits: Estimated actuals are made before the year closes. Restricted money (grants for set purposes) cannot pay general costs, so the unrestricted figures matter most for solvency.
